title: Audit policy-denied Skill actions
goal: Ensure a Skill rejected by M6 policy has a complete denial and failed-observation trail, without falsely recording execution.
context: M6 currently omits skillID from actionDenied payloads and does not emit observationProduced for denied proposals. This makes denied Skill attempts difficult to trace and breaks the action-to-observation audit chain.
forbidden_changes: Do not emit actionExecuted for a policy-denied proposal.
Do not invoke SkillExecutionBoundary after denial.
Do not change policy or approval semantics.
acceptance_criteria: actionDenied includes skillID and actionID for a denied Skill proposal.
observationProduced includes the same skillID/actionID and succeeded=false, verified=false.
A denied Skill never emits actionExecuted and the goal aborts.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Preserve fail-closed policy behavior; add only denial/observation metadata and regression coverage.
